stated: Reform UK will mandate that public toilets and changing areas must provide single-sex facilities.

source.quote: Mandate Single Sex Spaces Public toilets and changing areas must provide single sex facilities.

bearing_set.reason: Mandating single-sex facilities directly implicates equal treatment and anti-discrimination law (Equality Act 2010 protected characteristics, particularly gender reassignment) and the legal rights framework governing how trans people access public spaces — a core O9 question about equal treatment and treatment of minorities.

The policy is a state mandate on facility operators and effectively coerces transgender individuals to use facilities inconsistent with their gender presentation, directly engaging bodily autonomy and freedom from state coercion.

Proponents advance a concrete safety mechanism — mandating sex separation in changing areas and toilets to reduce voyeurism and sexual assault risk to natal women and girls — which would move crime/safety indicators if the mechanism holds.

membership_note: Three fundamentals bear on this policy: O9 (equal treatment and minority protections for trans people vs. natal-sex-based rights), O10 (the coercive mandate on operators and the bodily-autonomy constraint on trans individuals), and O5 (the contested safety case for sex-separated facilities). The O9 and O10 signals are rival and must be scored independently.
